description: Set a Task's state. 'with a helper': handed to a helper agent that is working on it (several Tasks can be). 'waiting on you': you are waiting on the Developer, such as for them to test something by hand; the dashboard shows the Goal as waiting on them, so tell them what you need. 'checked': you checked a helper's work (tests, review) but it is not merged or released yet; give evidence, one short line on what you checked ("715 passed, live send OK"), which the Developer sees on the step. With 'with a helper', give helper_branch, helper_folder (the worktree path) and helper_label: they are recorded with the Task and shown in get_status and on the dashboard, and get_status warns when a finished Task's helper branch still has unmerged work. 'released': merged and out (shipped, installed or published); counts as done. 'pending', 'in progress' and 'done' work too (in progress follows start_task's one-at-a-time rule). Set a state as soon as it changes, such as 'checked' right after you check a helper's work, so the Developer's dashboard keeps moving. If the project has a helper limit (get_status shows it), keep at most that many Tasks with a helper: one more is still set, with a warning. To drop a Task, use drop_task.

evidence.description: With state 'checked': one short line on what you checked, such as '715 passed, live send OK'. Give it: the Developer sees it on the dashboard step.

goal.description: The claimed Goal's ID, such as 'ship-oauth-login'. Needed only when this Session holds several Goals.

helper_branch.description: With state 'with a helper': the git branch the helper works on, such as 'feat/export'. Recorded so a branch left behind can be found later.

helper_folder.description: With state 'with a helper': the helper's worktree folder (its path).

helper_label.description: With state 'with a helper': a label for the helper, such as the model it runs on ('Sonnet').

project.description: Another project's plan to use instead of this one's: its name or ID on the dashboard, or its folder's full path. Changes there are marked as made from this project. Leave out for this project.

name: set_task_state
title: Set Task state
